text:
Maya: morning all :wave: ran the quarterly access snapshot overnight; surfaced a few oddities across projects A/B/C, leaving notes below.
Jon: thanks — can you call out the high-priority ones first?
Maya: sure. top three: 1) 12 service accounts still granted `project-admin` in proj-B, 2) two KMS keys in prod with `kms:Encrypt` for a helper lambda that hasn't had traffic in 6 months, 3) one user in infra group with dual awsconsole + org-admin.
Olivia: ugh. where did the SA grants come from? rollout last year?
Maya: looks like a CI migration last July — the terraform module granted admin at project scope for convenience and never got scoped-down. flagged the tf module owner in the audit logs: `user: deploy-bot@infra` and a manual grant by `jon@infra` from 2024-08-09.
Jon: that was me for the quick migration, forgot to follow up. my bad.
Maya: no worries — propose this plan: a) schedule canary revoke for 3 SAs this afternoon, b) update terraform to grant `roles/editor` -> then to narrow custom roles over two sprints, c) rotate KMS grants to the lambda to a new key with strict IAM.
Olivia: agree. also want an evidence trail for compliance — can we attach the audit entries to the ticket?
Maya: yes — pulled the audit query, paste here:
```
# BigQuery audit query (sample)
SELECT protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor,
       protopayload_auditlog.servicedata.policyDelta.bindingDeltas.role AS role,
       protopayload_auditlog.requestMetadata.callerIp AS ip,
       timestamp
FROM `org_a.audit_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.labels.project_id IN ("proj-B","proj-C")
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), timestamp, DAY) < 400
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Jon: nice. I'll attach the query results to ENGSEC-4521.
security-bot: automated note: found KMS key grant to `lambda-helper-sa@proj-prod` with last_use 2024-09-02; no rotation policy configured.
Maya: thanks bot. question for @devops-oncall — for the canary revokes, what's our rollback if the CI job breaks?
devops-oncall: we can pin a fallback SA and temporarily route the job to a dedicated runner pool with restricted perms. rollback steps: reapply original binding via terraform state restore and redeploy the pipeline. I can run the canary at 17:00 and monitor for 30 minutes. :eyes:
Olivia: also want to run a quick vuln triage on that lambda — if it hasn't had traffic maybe we deprecate it entirely.
Maya: good call. I'll open a deprecation RFC and add owners.
Jon: timeline: canary revoke + KMS grant rotation today, terraform change PR next week, full role-slimming sprint in two weeks.
Maya: assigning actions: Maya -> run BQ query export + attach to ticket; Jon -> prepare terraform PR with scoped role; Olivia -> triage lambda + recommend deprecate or rekey; devops-oncall -> run canary revoke at 17:00 and monitor.
Olivia: I'll also check if any other teams reference that key via secrets manager — share results by EOD.
Maya: noted. final note for auditors: we will produce a remediation timeline and evidence bundle (BQ logs, PR links, canary runbook) before the end of the month. tagging compliance for visibility. :lock:
Jon: thanks, team.
Maya: thanks — will post updates in this thread as things land.
